title: FACE Act Repeal Act of 2025
committees: H-Judiciary Committee: Referred To 2025-01-21 -> Markup By 2025-06-10
latest_action: Ordered to be Reported in the Nature of a Substitute by the Yeas and Nays: 13 - 10.
summary: FACE Act Repeal Act of 2025 This bill repeals provisions of federal criminal law that prohibit conduct intended to injure, intimidate, or interfere with persons who are seeking to (1) obtain or provide reproductive health services, or (2) exercise their right of religious freedom at a place of religious worship.

journey.note: Reported by committee; waiting for a floor vote
